mcqs.question: Which authority approved the ₹10,000 crore Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) Price Stabilisation Fund?
options: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
mcqs.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the ₹10,000 crore ATF Price Stabilisation Fund. The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas provides grants for financing the fund, while Indian Oil is one of the participating Oil Marketing Companies; Hardeep Singh Puri is the Minister associated with the ministry.
